title: Contact and appointments
subtitle: WhatsApp-based coordination. I listen before we book.

sections.heading: Best way to reach us
sections.body: WhatsApp is the fastest channel for questions, availability, and coordination. For formal invoices or referrals, email works too.

sections.heading: Hours
sections.note: By appointment only. I'm not in the clinic all day: we schedule what works for you.

sections.heading: Location and access
sections.body: Ometz Dental · Auditores de la Guerra del Chaco 617, Barrio Mburucuyá, Asunción, Paraguay. Two minutes walk from Mburucuyá main square. Access and parking instructions sent at booking.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: Accepting new patients. Soft launch before July 26, 2026. First appointment usually available within the first or second week from opening.
